shortlist.label: Posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome

shortlist.label: Synthetic cannabinoid-induced acute cerebral vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of synthetic cannabis use and imaging studies showing edema

raw.rationale: The patient's history of synthetic cannabis use, recent seizure, and imaging studies showing diffuse bilateral cortical and subcortical edema are consistent with toxic leukoencephalopathy, a condition known to be associated with synthetic cannabis use.

rejected.label: Posterior Reversible Encephalopathy Syndrome
rejected.why: While the patient has edema, it is diffuse and bilateral, not limited to the posterior regions typically seen in PRES.

rejected.label: Epilepsy
rejected.why: The patient has no prior seizure disorder, making new-onset epilepsy less likely.

rejected.label: Cannabinoid Hyperemesis Syndrome
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms do not include the cyclic vomiting typically seen in CHS.

rejected.label: Hypertensive Encephalopathy
rejected.why: There is no mention of the patient having hypertension or elevated blood pressure readings.
